name: Voidreth
detailed_description:
WELCOME TO VOIDRETH

Step aboard the CIRCADIA, your orbiting command vessel—and your only safe haven. From here, Operators descend into lunar ghost zones, where anomalous signals and deadly entities haunt the dark corridors of long-abandoned outposts.

Voidreth is a sci-fi horror extraction game, where survival depends on the tools you bring, the choices you make, and your ability to outwit an intelligent, relentless enemy. This is not a fight you win with bullets—this is a hunt for truth, a race against death, and a test of nerve.

🔍 Phase One: Identify the Entity

Your mission begins with a name and a purpose: uncover the nature of the Entity lurking within the lunar base. Use high-tech equipment like:

• A.R.I.S. – Analyze anomalies for bonus credits.
• EM-Nexus – Detect electromagnetic signatures.
• TRX-3 Tracer – Follow spectral residue across rooms.
• Wraith-COM – Pinpoint ghost activity through spectral feedback.

Your helmet-integrated dual vision scanners reveal hidden truths—but they won’t protect you. In this phase, stealth is your only defense. The Entity is aware. It is watching. And it is not alone.

🚨 Phase Two: Secure the Relic. Survive the Extraction.

Once identified, the Relic must be found and carried to the extraction zone. But the Entity won’t let you go so easily.

Choose your loadout wisely: only three tools per mission. Will you bring defensive gear—or go full analysis and fly blind in the final sprint?

Activate the extraction portal under pressure, evade death in close quarters, and make the call—fight back, or disappear into the void.

💼 Progression & Replayability

Extract successfully to earn credits. Invest in new defenses. Master each outpost.

Current content includes:
• 6 unique tools (1 defensive)
• 3 lunar base locations (small to medium scale)
• Multiple entity types and behavior patterns

More bases, tools, modes, and threats are planned during Early Access—with community input at the core of development.

🚨 Please note: This game is currently in Early Access and still under active development. The core features are implemented and fully playable, but you may encounter bugs, glitches, or missing audio elements that could impact the gameplay experience. Your feedback is highly appreciated as we continue to improve and expand the game.

short_description: A sci-fi horror extraction experience set on haunted lunar outposts. Use high-tech tools to investigate anomalies, identify deadly entities, and extract an ancient relic, before the void, the dark, and what lurks within consume you completely.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10 32bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 CPU @ 3.00GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: -

content_descriptors.notes: In the game, all scenes primarily consist of regular battles, typically with robots and monsters. However, at various intervals, "jump scares" caused by anomalies occur. These may include ghosts running towards the player while screaming, sound files playing intermittently to startle the player, and spider creatures crawling out of holes and advancing towards the player as well as teleporting creatures.
